headline: Approved FY26 student activity balances, a new theater club account, and a job description for Assistant Director of Special Education; updated operating protocols tabled.
summary: Members heard the superintendent's report and a update on technical and adaptive changes. They approved the consent agenda and several items, including a job description for Assistant Director of Special Education. A vote on updated operating protocols was tabled until October 28, 2026.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including meeting minutes, warrants, transfers, a donation, and gifts, unanimously.
Approved the job description for Assistant Director of Special Education unanimously.
Approved the establishment of a new Student Activity Account for the Gloucester High School Theater/Drama Club unanimously.
Approved the FY 26 Student Activities, their objectives, and balances unanimously.
Tabled the vote on updated School Committee Operating Protocols until October 28, 2026.

decision_evidence.quote: On a motion by Ms. Prince, seconded by Ms. Wiessen, it was unanimously VOTED: To approve the consent agenda as noted above.
On a motion by Mr. Melvin, seconded by Ms. Wiessen, it was unanimously VOTED: To approve the job description for Assistant Director of Special Education.

On a motion by Ms. Prince, seconded by Chairperson Clancy, it was unanimously VOTED: To approve the establishment of a new Student Activity Account for the Gloucester High School Theater/Drama Club, pursuant to M.G.L., Chapter 71, Section 47.
On a motion by Ms. Prince, seconded by Ms. Wiessen, it was unanimously VOTED: To approve the FY 26 Student Activities, their objectives, and balances, pursuant to M.G.L., Chapter 71, Section 47.
A. Vote on updated School Committee Operating Protocols — This agenda item was tabled until the next meeting on October 28, 2026

Our mission is for all students to be successful, engaged, lifelong learners.

Wednesday, October 14, 2026 
Gloucester High School Library and via Zoom 
32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930 
6:00 p.m. 
Members Present  Administration Present 
Kathleen Clancy, Chairperson Amy Pasquarello, Superintendent  
William Melvin, Vice Chairperson Dr. Catherine Tucker, Assistant Superintendent 
Laura Wiessen, Secretary 
Heather Dagle 
Andrea Liacos  
Melissa Teixeira Prince 
Paul Lundberg, Mayor 
This meeting was conducted with the School Committee in person 
and the public participating in person and remotely via Zoom. 
I. CALL TO ORDER – Chairperson Clancy called the meeting to order at 6:01 p.m. and
stated the mission of the Gloucester Public Schools.
Effective August 16, 2023, the public is welcome to attend meetings in person.
Alternatively, the public may attend through the Zoom link provided on the agenda.  The
meeting notice will reflect if the meeting is via Zoom only.  As the recent amendments to
the Open Meeting Law allow, the School Committee may continue to hold meetings
remotely.  Please note the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if
technological problems interrupt the remote connection.  If you are calling in on a phone,
you can press Star 9 (*9) to request to speak.  If you are watching on a computer or
device, there is a “raise hand” button that you can tap or press to request to speak.  Please
use either of these options during Oral Communications to be recognized to speak.
